explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/1182 (Burr–Erdős–Faudree–Rousseau–Schelp): f(n) is maximal such that there is a connected graph with n vertices and f(n) edges with R(K_3,G) = 2n−1; 'Estimate f(n) and F(n)'. In Lean IsTriangleGood G is graphRamsey K_3 G = 2n − 1 (least N such that every graph C on N vertices contains a triangle or has G in its complement), and f n is the maximum edge count of a connected 3-good graph on Fin n; tests in small_values agree with the published table. The value question reads 'estimate f(n)' as f =Θ[atTop] answer. The definition is faithful; as with other 'estimate' questions the statement is satisfied by the trivial answer f itself and fixes Θ as the required precision (the known bounds n^{3/2}(log n)^{1/2} ≪ f(n) ≪ n^{5/3}(log n)^{2/3} are far apart), which the docstring states but does not qualify.
